name: oxford-hack
description: Root developer commands. Frontend deps live in frontend/, platform (Python) deps in platform/ (uv).

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend ci && cd platform && uv sync --locked
scripts.contracts:generate: cd platform && uv run python scripts/generate_contracts.py && uv run python scripts/make_fixtures.py && cd ../frontend && npm run contracts:types
scripts.contracts:check: cd platform && uv run python scripts/generate_contracts.py --check && uv run python scripts/make_fixtures.py --check && cd ../frontend && npm run contracts:types:check
